title: Project Manager, Launch Operations
jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. As Netflix’s global member base grows from 300+ million members enjoying local stories globally, the ability to operate at scale without compromising on quality is paramount to our success. Netflix is looking for a skilled Project Manager to join its Launch Operations team in India. This team will be part of a broader operational hub strategy and manages the entire launch readiness process, including on-service pre-promotional milestones, by combining rigorous Project Management and risk mitigation with a strategic, member-first mindset. This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Project manager with a knack for workflow innovation in service of delivering Netflix titles to our global members, at scale. If you are analytically minded and your attention to detail is unmatched, you excel at challenging the status quo and influencing change, you thrive in a global team, possess a high level of intellectual curiosity, and demonstrate strong judgment in the face of ambiguity, then this role is for you. The role gets messy and the work we do is predominantly behind-the-scenes. We are the engine that keeps the Product moving. So if you can keep your ego in check, then we definitely want you to apply! The role involves managing a large volume of titles across the global slate, driving effective communication and alignment across multiple stakeholders in different regions, tracking and managing dependencies and moving launch targets, predicting and mitigating risks, and ensuring our titles launch with a full suite of assets. What You’ll Do: * The role has an equally important duality to it
- You will own and be accountable for the end-to-end, on-service project management of titles from across the globe. While multiple teams (internal and external) are responsible for creating and delivering assets, you will be responsible for ensuring those assets are coming in at the right time and keeping the project (each title) moving towards a predetermined launch date that all of your stakeholders are aligned to. * You will help shape and redesign existing workflows to help accelerate the efficiency of our operations in line with key business objectives for our group. * Partner with internal and external teams (vendors) to ensure operational momentum and seamlessness across launches. * Exercise sound judgment and risk mitigation to create/modify delivery and launch plans including use cases that fall outside the norm. * Partner with our Technology, Engineering, Partnerships, and Quality Control teams within Global Product Creative Operations, to guide tooling, workflow, and vendor needs to help scale operations. What You’ll Need: * Excellent project management skills and the ability to keep multiple priorities moving at the same time * Extensive experience in contributing to scale initiatives/projects with clear business impact * Experience in a global organization and team * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * An analytical and innovative mindset * A passion for operations and a thirst to do more with less, to work smarter not harder * A tools-first mentality reserving human activity for where judgment and communication are critical * The ability to build deep cross-functional relationships * A business and team-first attitude (naturally selfless) * A self-starter mentality (takes initiative) * An optimistic, solutions-driven attitude in the most challenging situations * Fluency in an additional language is a bonus * The ability to adapt to the Netflix culture and values Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

title: Manager, Physical Security
jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. We are seeking an experienced Physical Security Manager to support our APAC Enterprise Security team. This position will be responsible for all physical security operations for our offices in India. This Mumbai based role will report to the APAC Enterprise Security Leader, based in Singapore. You will be responsible for building and maintaining our physical risk and security capabilities, keeping our people safe as well as optimizing preparedness and response to incidents. You will drive the implementation, development and deployment of a comprehensive physical security program, fostering collaborative relationships with Workplace, Content Risk Management, Talent, Legal, Comms and our GSOC amongst other cross-functional partners including the India Leadership Team. You’re a thoughtful and tenured security expert with experience in developing regional corporate security requirements in a multinational company with a strong understanding of the local political landscape. It won’t be a one size fits all approach
- we have a unique culture that is embraced across the business. You understand that legacy, process or best practice security solutions are not what will make you successful. You will be empowered to make things happen and have a natural inclination to work within a high-performance culture that is fast-paced and self-directed. Responsibilities * Articulate relevant security risks and provide guidance to cross-functional partners and Regional/Country leadership. * Maintain a proactive and strategic security approach when looking at business needs. * Ensure a baseline approach for the physical security program to help assess the risk to our locations, support selection and design of new facilities * Support the rollout management team to support publicity and Marcomm events as required * Leverage intelligence in the volatile geopolitical space to keep our workspaces and employees safe * Increase resilience across the business by developing innovative methods to engage employees as they relate to personal and travel risks * Develop and present security education awareness training programs * Strength and maintain collaborative external partnerships with local law enforcement, federal agencies, third-party vendors and community organizations Qualifications & Experience * At least 10 to 15 years of experience with increasing scope, responsibility and complexity at a multinational company * Relevant degree/professional qualification in security or related field * Demonstrated experience in needs to stakeholder * Experience managing guarding contracts at the account level, and a proven track record of optimising deployments, and making risk based efficiencies * Event Security Management experience, leading high profile events in different markets/countries * Capable of adapting to and leaning in to risk independently with a self-starter mentality and drive results in a fast-paced environment * Demonstrated management experience in building, managing, mentoring, and inspiring teams, with a proven track record of leveraging data to drive significant business impact * Exceptional title: Manager, Social Marketing
jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. This is not just a community manager role. This is not about posting calendars and managing handles. This is internet marketing at a cultural scale. We're looking for a cultural operator. A conversation hacker. A genuine content obsessive. Someone who understands the Indian internet deeply, watches everything, and knows how to turn moments into movements. You're as creative as you are analytical
- as comfortable pitching a wild idea as you are reading a content slate and knowing exactly which title deserves the internet's attention this week. Loves content coming from different regions in India
- Hindi and South. Social at Netflix is a growth engine, an intelligence system, and a brand love machine. If you can balance instinct with insight and culture with craft, this is your playground. The Mandate ## Build and Lead Conversation * Grow and nurture the most engaged OTT community in India. * Drive always-on cultural presence beyond Title launches * Ensure Netflix India consistently leads monthly share of voice and shapes how titles travel across press and KOL ecosystems. ## Turn Social into Strategic Intelligence * Mine real-time audience feedback, sentiment, and heat signals. * Identify breakout moments early and course-correct underperformance fast. * Represent the audience voice in internal forums and influence marketing pivots. You are both a cultural antenna and a performance radar. Build Brand Love Through Culture * Show up meaningfully across festivals, cultural flashpoints, and everyday usage moments. * Create and scale social IP that reinforces Netflix's personality. * Work with creators for relevance and credibility, not transactional reach. * Bring a programmer's instinct to social
- know which stories, scenes, and moments from our slate are worth amplifying, and when, across a title's entire lifecycle. ## Drive Cross-Functional Impact * Work closely with internal teams and marcomms partners to ensure strong ownership on campaigns; align with cross-functional efforts led by Content, Brand, FSM, Publicity, Comms, Product, Partnerships and other teams. * Co-own tentpole brand beats across the year. * Own reactive excellence and boosting strategy to maximize cultural impact. ## Expand Beyond Owned Handles * Recognize that the next wave of growth sits beyond metro-heavy legacy communities. * Partner with creators, collaborators, and ecosystem players to widen footprint. Who You Are * 8 to 10+ years of experience in social marketing, having worked in the entertainment industry, network/studio marketing, global lifestyle / digital-first brands, or a creative agency (experience in the entertainment category preferred). * Deep fluency in Indian internet behavior across cohorts and regions. * A genuinely creative mind
- someone who concepts, not just executes; who pitches ideas that make a room go quiet. * Real content programming instincts
- you read a slate, know how to sequence conversation around a title's lifecycle, and can spot what's culturally primed to travel before anyone else does. * An obsessive, personal love of content
- you watch everything, have opinions on everything, and that excitement shows up in the work. * Able to balance creative instinct with data-led decision making. * Comfortable operating in ambiguity with high ownership. * Strong narrative thinker who understands how social shapes perception. Why This Role Matters At Netflix India, social does not amplify culture. It actively shapes it. You will influence what trends, what headlines travel, how fandoms form, and how Netflix shows up in everyday conversation across India. If you want to build cultural momentum, not just manage feeds, we would love to hear from you. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. title: Associate, APAC Revenue Analytics
jobDescription: Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. The Finance & Strategy team’s Revenue Analytics function plays a central role in developing insights that inform our growth and monetization strategy. Our revenue and membership forecasts are critical components that feed into the corporate planning process for spending and resource allocation across content, commerce, and technology. We are seeking a highly analytical and intellectually curious Associate to join our APAC team. You will play a key role in supporting insights and analyses that shape Netflix’s growth in India and the wider APAC region. To be successful, you are a self-starter with a keen analytical eye and proven experience as a cross-functional partner. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, bring a builder mindset and can navigate ambiguity. You are a strong communicator, capable of conveying complex ideas effectively to a broad set of stakeholders. This role is based out of Mumbai, India and will include occasional travel to Netflix’s offices in USA and Singapore. Responsibilities * Support strategic value-added analyses to understand the drivers behind membership and revenue growth in the APAC markets, derive actionable insights and feedback to collaborative cross-function stakeholders (Content, Partnerships, Ads, Payments, Product, Consumer Insights, Data Science etc.) * Assess and communicate the impact of business decisions such as price changes, content launches, and product innovations to facilitate planning and operational decisions * Analyze and evaluate the business impact of key external events such as competitor moves or country-specific events * Research, track and generate insights about the membership growth landscape * Be a key contributor to in-region pricing decisions, compiling internal and external intelligence to inform price and plan strategy * Collect cross-functional inputs to inform and support the revenue and membership forecasts * Support efforts to centralize and standardize revenue performance reporting, helping identify cross-region best practices to enhance scalability and consistency in business analytics Qualifications A successful candidate should have the ability to combine comprehensive data analytics with sound business intuition and judgment, and effectively communicate analytical insights to stakeholders. Given the questions asked of our team are often urgent in nature and have an immediate impact on how the business makes decisions, the individual coming into this role must be able to deliver accurate results promptly. They must thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a high level of intellectual curiosity, focus on generating results, and exhibit the highest personal and professional standards of integrity and ethics. * 5+ years of experience in an analytical & strategy role (e.g. business analytics, tech strategy) * Proficiency in SQL & MS Excel required * Experience building quantitative models in Excel or other modeling tools * Experience writing complex SQL queries to analyze large data sets * Other coding and technical experience (e.g. VBA, Python, Tableau, etc.) is a plus, but not a prerequisite * Ability to independently extract, explore, and analyze big data from both internal and external sources to guide the analysis of complex issues * Possess a high level of intellectual curiosity, discipline, and flexibility * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Highly skilled in preparing effective presentations (Google Slides, MS Power Point) with a clear narrative and impactful visuals * Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build successful relationships at all levels * Bachelor’s degree with an emphasis on quantitative coursework * Experience of India market and the broader APAC region as well as the streaming & tech industry is preferred, but not required Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

title: Associate, Production Finance - India
jobDescription:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments. If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you. ## ## The Opportunity As an Associate
- Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India. This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy-partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery. You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success. ## ## What You'll Do ### Partner with Productions * Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production. * Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations. * Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes. Drive Financial Excellence * Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts. * Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early. * Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections. * Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions. * Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance. ### Deliver Meaningful Insights * Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies. * Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations. * Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions. ### Strengthen Financial Operations * Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records. * Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools. * Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting. * Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions. ## ## What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers-you want to understand the story behind them. title: Manager, Production Management, Unscripted (India)
jobDescription: Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. Netflix is seeking a Manager, Production Management to join the India Production team and support an expanding slate of Unscripted Originals. This role will partner closely with the Unscripted Production Management Lead, Creative, Production Finance, Business & Legal Affairs, Production Safety, Post Production, Marketing, Publicity, and external production partners to support titles from development through delivery. The position will play a critical role in evaluating production strategies, assessing budgets and schedules, mitigating risks, and helping productions deliver creative ambition responsibly and efficiently. As Netflix continues to expand its Unscripted slate across formats, scale, and complexity, we are looking for a strong production manager who can successfully partner across teams, support multiple productions simultaneously, and help drive operational excellence across the slate. The Role A successful candidate will be passionate about storytelling, highly organized, solutions-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously. This individual should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, building strong relationships across a diverse stakeholder group, and influencing decision-making through expertise and collaboration. They should possess strong production judgment, a deep understanding of unscripted production ecosystems, and the ability to identify risks and opportunities early in a project's lifecycle. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, exercises sound judgment, communicates clearly and concisely, and brings a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Responsibilities * Manage assigned Netflix Unscripted Originals from development through delivery. * Partner with the Unscripted Production Management Lead on production planning, execution, and operational priorities across the slate. * Evaluate production plans, budgets, schedules, staffing strategies, and operational approaches. * Work closely with production companies to identify efficiencies while preserving creative intent. * Support production feasibility assessments and operational risk evaluations during development and greenlight discussions. * Provide visibility on production status, emerging risks, key decisions, and cost implications. * Support productions through prep, shoot, post-production, and delivery. * Drive alignment across internal cross-functional stakeholders and external production partners. * Contribute to the development and implementation of production workflows, best practices, and operational standards across the Unscripted slate. * Support innovation in production methodologies, technology adoption, sustainability initiatives, and evolving production workflows. * Demonstrate the ability to independently manage productions while escalating risks, key decisions, and business impacts appropriately. Requirements * 10-15 years of hands-on production experience across Unscripted television, streaming content, documentary formats, reality programming, competition formats, factual entertainment, or large-scale live productions. * Experience working as an Executive Producer or equivalent leadership role across multiple long-form productions. * Demonstrated experience managing productions from development through delivery. * Strong budgeting, scheduling, and production planning expertise. * Deep understanding of the unique production challenges associated with Unscripted formats, including multi-camera productions, competition formats, documentary-style productions, large cast and contestant management, and location-intensive shoots. * Strong understanding of production workflows, crew structures, vendor ecosystems, and production operations. * Proven ability to identify risks early and develop practical solutions. * Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. * Strong attention to detail and operational rigor. * Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. * Comfortable operating independently while collaborating effectively across teams. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, and production management tools. Additional Skills * Strong understanding of post-production workflows, including editorial, finishing, music, and delivery processes. * Familiarity with production technology, cloud-based workflows, remote collaboration tools, and emerging AI applications within content production. * Experience working across international productions or global streaming platforms. * Understanding of production sustainability practices and operational efficiency initiatives. * Familiarity with health and safety, duty of care, and production risk management practices. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.
